@allocation.definition: Use usage day and half-open owner intervals. Split direct effective cost by team share then center, unmatched goes to Unassigned (-1). Shared rows are removed from direct cost and distributed by calendar usage month and pool. Preserve all dollars including resource-less direct expense.

@closing.definition: Keep one delivery per charge_id, highest revision then arrived then export_id. For an as-of close, first keep arrivals up to and including cutoff UTC date. Signed credit and purchase postings are included in net billed. Join invoice on invoice_id for posting clock. Charge day is the economic usage clock. Month 13 is January 2026.

@codes.definition: X denotes SKU 0, R-number denotes resource id, K-number denotes commitment id. Named projects, regions, classes and centers resolve via their name fields.

@commitments.definition: Eligibility uses contract account, SKU and term. Applications are contract-charge allocations. Savings equals covered units at dated SKU-region contracted rate less applied amortization. Service expense is applied plus unused; purchase cash uses billed purchase rows.

@costs.definition: Amounts in USD. Billed is invoiced cash, effective recognizes amortized expense, contracted is eligible on-demand price times quantity, list is undiscounted. Usage comparisons use category usage. Effective includes all categories unless explicitly limited to usage.

@fiscal.definition: Budget is approved per fiscal period and center. Actuals are allocated effective cost mapped by usage day to half-open fiscal periods. Fiscal Q3 is periods 7–9. Variance percentage is 100 times (actual minus budget) divided by budget. Other quarterly reports use calendar quarters.

@labels.definition: Use date-active tag intervals, trim/lower keys and values, discard blanks. Usable means exactly one distinct normalized value. Active resources have metered usage in the period. JSON lifecycle is resource metadata; missing path is unknown.

@output.definition: Completed transactions are project-day outputs. Aggregate numerator and denominator independently before dividing. Missing daily output is zero when assessing activity. Undefined division returns NULL. Quarter comparisons use ratios of sums.

@variance.definition: SKU changes use realized contracted usage dollars per metered unit. Bridge volume at base mix and price, then mix at base regional prices, then prices at current regional units. Credits' contribution to a billed change uses signed credit change divided by signed total change.

account.ddl: CREATE TABLE account ( id INTEGER, provider_id INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY (id), FOREIGN KEY (provider_id) REFERENCES provider(id) );

charge_revision.ddl: CREATE TABLE charge_revision ( charge_id INTEGER, revision INTEGER, export_id INTEGER, arrived DATE, invoice_id INTEGER, day DATE, resource_id INTEGER, meter_id INTEGER, sku_id INTEGER, category VARCHAR, origin_id INTEGER, pool VARCHAR, contract_id INTEGER, billed DECIMAL(18,6), effective DECIMAL(18,6), list_cost DECIMAL(18,6), contracted DECIMAL(18,6), memo VARCHAR, PRIMARY KEY (export_id), FOREIGN KEY (invoice_id) REFERENCES invoice(id), FOREIGN KEY (resource_id) REFERENCES resource(id), FOREIGN KEY (meter_id) REFERENCES usage_day(id), FOREIGN KEY (sku_id) REFERENCES sku(id), FOREIGN KEY (contract_id) REFERENCES commitment(id) );

commitment.ddl: CREATE TABLE commitment ( id INTEGER, sku_id INTEGER, account_id INTEGER, first_day DATE, end_day DATE, purchase DECIMAL(18,6), monthly DECIMAL(18,6), PRIMARY KEY (id), FOREIGN KEY (sku_id) REFERENCES sku(id), FOREIGN KEY (account_id) REFERENCES account(id) );

commitment_application.ddl: CREATE TABLE commitment_application ( contract_id INTEGER, charge_id INTEGER, covered INTEGER, applied DECIMAL(18,6), PRIMARY KEY (contract_id, charge_id), FOREIGN KEY (contract_id) REFERENCES commitment(id) );

cost_center.ddl: CREATE TABLE cost_center ( id INTEGER, name VARCHAR, PRIMARY KEY (id) );

fiscal_period.ddl: CREATE TABLE fiscal_period ( id INTEGER, first_day DATE, end_day DATE, PRIMARY KEY (id) );

invoice.ddl: CREATE TABLE invoice ( id INTEGER, account_id INTEGER, posting_month INTEGER, control DECIMAL(18,6), PRIMARY KEY (id), FOREIGN KEY (account_id) REFERENCES account(id) );

monthly_budget.ddl: CREATE TABLE monthly_budget ( period_id INTEGER, center_id INTEGER, budget DECIMAL(18,6), PRIMARY KEY (period_id, center_id), FOREIGN KEY (period_id) REFERENCES fiscal_period(id), FOREIGN KEY (center_id) REFERENCES cost_center(id) );

output_day.ddl: CREATE TABLE output_day ( project_id INTEGER, day DATE, transactions INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY (project_id, day), FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES project(id) );

price_schedule.ddl: CREATE TABLE price_schedule ( sku_id INTEGER, region_id INTEGER, first_day DATE, end_day DATE, list_rate DECIMAL(18,6), contract_rate DECIMAL(18,6), PRIMARY KEY (sku_id, region_id, first_day), FOREIGN KEY (sku_id) REFERENCES sku(id), FOREIGN KEY (region_id) REFERENCES region(id) );

project.ddl: CREATE TABLE project ( id INTEGER, account_id INTEGER, name VARCHAR, PRIMARY KEY (id), FOREIGN KEY (account_id) REFERENCES account(id) );

provider.ddl: CREATE TABLE provider ( id INTEGER, name VARCHAR, PRIMARY KEY (id) );

region.ddl: CREATE TABLE region ( id INTEGER, name VARCHAR, PRIMARY KEY (id) );

resource.ddl: CREATE TABLE resource ( id INTEGER, project_id INTEGER, sku_id INTEGER, region_id INTEGER, metadata JSON, PRIMARY KEY (id), FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES project(id), FOREIGN KEY (sku_id) REFERENCES sku(id), FOREIGN KEY (region_id) REFERENCES region(id) );

resource_owner.ddl: CREATE TABLE resource_owner ( resource_id INTEGER, team_id INTEGER, first_day DATE, end_day DATE, share DECIMAL(18,6), PRIMARY KEY (resource_id, team_id, first_day), FOREIGN KEY (resource_id) REFERENCES resource(id), FOREIGN KEY (team_id) REFERENCES team(id) );

resource_tag.ddl: CREATE TABLE resource_tag ( resource_id INTEGER, tag_key VARCHAR, tag_value VARCHAR, first_day DATE, end_day DATE, PRIMARY KEY (resource_id, tag_key, first_day), FOREIGN KEY (resource_id) REFERENCES resource(id) );

service.ddl: CREATE TABLE service ( id INTEGER, class_id INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY (id), FOREIGN KEY (class_id) REFERENCES service_class(id) );

service_class.ddl: CREATE TABLE service_class ( id INTEGER, name VARCHAR, PRIMARY KEY (id) );

shared_split.ddl: CREATE TABLE shared_split ( month_id INTEGER, pool VARCHAR, center_id INTEGER, weight DECIMAL(18,6), PRIMARY KEY (month_id, pool, center_id), FOREIGN KEY (center_id) REFERENCES cost_center(id) );

sku.ddl: CREATE TABLE sku ( id INTEGER, service_id INTEGER, unit VARCHAR, PRIMARY KEY (id), FOREIGN KEY (service_id) REFERENCES service(id) );

team.ddl: CREATE TABLE team ( id INTEGER, center_id INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY (id), FOREIGN KEY (center_id) REFERENCES cost_center(id) );

usage_day.ddl: CREATE TABLE usage_day ( id INTEGER, resource_id INTEGER, day DATE, units INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY (id), FOREIGN KEY (resource_id) REFERENCES resource(id) );
